context: Tests whether the agent writes a skill body in imperative form, includes a complete copy-paste-ready example showing the full working artifact, and populates a Common Failures section with domain-specific (non-generic) failure modes.

checklist.name: No hedging language
checklist.description: The SKILL.md body does NOT contain any of the words 'prefer', 'consider', or 'try to' as instruction qualifiers

checklist.name: Imperative verbs present
checklist.description: The SKILL.md body contains at least 3 distinct imperative instruction openers from: 'Do not', 'Use', 'Run', 'Check', 'Report', 'Read', 'Verify', 'Reject', 'Confirm', 'Extract'

checklist.name: Complete example present
checklist.description: SKILL.md includes a complete example that shows the entire expected output or artifact (not just a code snippet or partial fragment) — e.g., a full review comment template or a full workflow trace

checklist.name: Example is self-contained
checklist.description: The example in SKILL.md can be understood and used without reading surrounding prose — it is not a fragment that depends on unstated context

checklist.name: Common failures section exists
checklist.description: SKILL.md contains a 'Common Failures' or 'Common Mistakes' section (or equivalent heading)

checklist.name: Failures are domain-specific
checklist.description: At least one listed failure mode is specific to code review (e.g., 'approving API contract breaks silently', 'flagging PII in test fixtures that never reach prod') — NOT a generic pitfall like 'missing error handling' or 'unclear variable names'

checklist.name: Boundaries section present
checklist.description: SKILL.md contains a '## Boundaries' section with at least one 'DOES' and one 'Does NOT' bullet

checklist.name: Name is lowercase-hyphenated
checklist.description: The 'name' field in frontmatter uses lowercase hyphenated format (e.g., 'code-review') — no spaces or uppercase
